Hi all — quick note on the reconciliation approach.

We have two clean paths here:
1) Reissue invoice #2027-04-27 as a corrected invoice that separates VAT (invoice becomes net + VAT line). That allows Celestia to match the VAT line to their remittance and avoids refunding and recharging. Estimated internal time: same day to reissue, 24 hours max to clear internal checks.

2) Apply a temporary credit for the VAT difference and re-invoice net amount. That requires a small manual credit and manual application once funds clear. Could introduce a short delay for Celestia's AR close.

Dylan — please attach the April usage extract (CSV) with token counts by model and route. Include columns: date, route, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, request_id. I'll attach our VAT runbook for reference.

Markus — which path do you prefer? If you want the reissue, confirm the billing address and VAT number for Celestia so we can ensure the invoice lines auto-populate correctly.

Attachments: vat_reconciliation_steps.docx, usage_extract_202704.csv

Thanks,
